addons.name: Balsamiq for Confluence Cloud | Wireframes & prototypes
addons.tagLine: Create wireframes & interactive prototypes to make specs visual, clear, and easy to build
addons.summary: Balsamiq is the AI-powered wireframing and prototyping tool for product and IT teams, built for Confluence. Rough out an idea, make it interactive, and embed it in the page where the decision gets made.

addons.name: Draw Wireframes, Mockup, Prototype & Diagrams for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Wireframming and diagramming tool. Whiteboard, Sketch, Flowchart, Org chart, Mind maps, ERD, UML, Network, Process, UIUX and more
addons.summary:
Mocky is a tool to draw UI mockups, wireframes and diagrams.
No need to switch apps, move around different platforms and Confluence.

addons.name: Glossary for Confluence Cloud
addons.tagLine: Augment your Confluence Wiki with a smart enterprise glossary
addons.summary: Augment your Confluence Wiki with a smart enterprise glossary. The glossary is the single source of definitions, keeping terms separated from the Wiki content. All Terms in pages are annotated with the definitions of the matching terms.

addons.name: morpheOm
addons.tagLine: Intelligent Drawing Tool for Diagrams & Mockups
addons.summary: morpheOm uses a combination of deep learning and other form of artificial intelligence to help you draw your diagrams easier and faster. Our goal is to provide you with painless tools to better create. Draw.io compatible.

addons.name: Looker for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Embedded analytics made easy for Looker Dashboards, Looks and Explores in Confluence
addons.summary: Embed reports — Bring all your business intelligence data into Confluence by way of Looker BI Platform

addons.name: Google Studio for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Easy to use embedded analytics for Looker Studio & Google Analytics reports
addons.summary: View your Data Studio reports inside Confluence

addons.name: CelesteCS Math for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Excel-style formulas, totals and charts for Confluence tables and Jira data
addons.summary: Excel-style formulas on Confluence pages: SUM, SUMIFS, IF, INDEX/MATCH and 45+ functions over table cells, other macros and live Jira data, plus Bar, Line and Pie charts. A spreadsheet-like layer for reports, budgets and projects.

addons.name: Advanced Word Importer for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Import Word documents into Confluence pages in three steps — formatting preserved
addons.summary: Convert Microsoft Word (.docx) files into Confluence pages instantly. Supports local upload or Confluence attachments, flexible page placement, document splitting by heading level, and automatic handling of tables, images, and rich text formatting

addons.name: Google Data Studio+ for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Sync and embed Google Data Studio (formerly Looker Studio) alongside notes or images in one beautiful tab macro
addons.summary: Sync and embed Google Data Studio alongside notes or images in one beautiful tab macro. Compatible with 150+ apps on the marketplace. Easily add Figma, Airtable, notes and much more in the same location.

addons.name: Looker Studio (Google Data Studio) for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Seamlessly embed Looker Studio into your Confluence pages for only $0.01
addons.summary: Seamlessly embed Looker Studio (Google Data Studio) into your Confluence pages by simply copy-pasting links. Quickly view your Looker Studio without leaving Confluence. No more chasing down missing files or trying to reconcile outdated versions.

addons.name: AI Voiceover and Narration by Tiny Loop
addons.tagLine: Generate cutting-edge, natural-sounding AI voiceovers in Confluence
addons.summary: Generate high-quality AI voiceovers in Confluence with ease, using OpenAI's APIs for natural sound, akin to ChatGPT's own voice. Perfect for enhancing videos and presentations.

addons.name: Stylus - Formatting Macros
addons.tagLine: Styled formatting macros for enhanced layout, navigation and engagement. Boost your user experience with fresh look & feel
addons.summary: The Stylus - Formatting Macros by Toros is a bag of useful macros to improve how your organization data is presented in Confluence.

addons.name: Link-a-Link DC URL Mapping for Confluence Cloud
addons.tagLine: Find migrated Confluence pages from old URLs and generate intelligent document links with IntellinQs
addons.summary: Link-a-Link helps teams migrate from Confluence Data Center to Cloud by resolving legacy URLs, page IDs, and titles using CSV mappings. IntellinQ also generates intelligent document links from configurable numbering schemes.

addons.name: WorkatoSight for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Workato architecture context and API evidence in Confluence
addons.summary: WorkatoSight brings Workato architecture evidence into Confluence with dashboards, page bylines, native macros, API governance, runtime evidence, and documentation coverage for architects, developers, and platform teams.

addons.name: Your Glossary
addons.tagLine: Quickly look up words and acronyms using definitions from your existing Confluence pages
addons.summary: Your Glossary allows you to look up acronyms, terms and phrases on any Confluence page and shows the definition from your pre-existing Confluence pages with tables of definitions.
